data.content: Plan attached. Root cause is two independent leaks: the reaper never covers ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}, and 634 trailing remove_dir_all lines only run on the happy path. Fix is (a) one shared RAII guard in a new path dev-dependency member crate crates/knots-test-support — required because knots is binary-only (no src/lib.rs), so tests/*.rs cannot import from src/ — and (b) extending scripts/repo/reap-stale-artifacts.sh to reap ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/knots-* dirs owned by the current user, reusing the existing stamp-file cutoff. Migration keeps root a PathBuf (ws.path().to_path_buf()) so ~600 &root uses are untouched; only the creation line changes and the trailing cleanup line is deleted. Watch two rail gaps a new member crate would slip through: make lint's clippy has no --workspace, and check-file-sizes.sh finds only under src tests — both are fixed in step 2. No child knots; sweep is staged as ordered commits.
